audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer chart was close to inverted against the content layer: phases[0..3].side read Irelia where win[0..3] reads Skill/Galio/Galio/Galio, and phases[4..6].side read Skill where win[4..6] reads Irelia.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Skill, Galio, Galio, Galio, Irelia, Irelia, Irelia and matches win[] exactly, and the level-6 flip is real: Vanguard's Edge Marks on hit and every Mark refreshes Bladesurge.
audit.corrected: All seven sides aligned to win[]; phases[4..6].why rewritten to Irelia's side and ratings moved to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4..6].why still described Galio owning level 6, first item and two items — the exact rows the chart gives Irelia.
audit.why: Vanguard's Edge is 125s at rank 1 and Marks everything it hits; Bladesurge costs 15 mana and refreshes on Marked targets, so her re-entry is faster than Shield of Durand's 16s at rank 3.
audit.corrected: Three whys rewritten with the real cooldowns and the Mark-reset engine.

audit.whatIsWrong: Seven content fields credited Irelia with TRUE DAMAGE ("true-damage resets", "true damage undercuts your defensive stats"). Nothing in her kit deals true damage. breakdown.cooldowns also had no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Ionian Fervor stacks attack speed and grants bonus damage on hit at max stacks — not true damage. Bladesurge heals and refreshes on Marked targets; Defiant Dance reduces PHYSICAL damage only, so your magic Q goes through it; Flawless Duet stuns only where the two blades converge.
audit.corrected: True-damage claims replaced with the real reset/on-hit/heal mechanics; cooldowns field now carries Flawless Duet 16s->10s, Vanguard's Edge 125s and Bladesurge 10s with its free refresh.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization said "Add anti-heal early into his sustain" — misgendered and unattributed.
audit.why: Bladesurge heals her on every cast and refreshes on Marked targets, which is what makes extended trades unwinnable without Grievous Wounds.
audit.corrected: Names Oblivion Orb and attributes the healing to Bladesurge.

notes: Worst chart in the slice: the full layer had Irelia winning levels 1-5 and 'Skill' from 6 onward, the near-opposite of win[] and packet.levelChart. All seven sides realigned with the three flipped whys rewritten in the same proposal; win[] was already correct so no content-layer win edits. Second real defect: seven fields asserted Irelia deals TRUE DAMAGE. She does not — Ionian Fervor grants attack speed and bonus on-hit damage at max stacks. Every reachable instance is corrected. Still standing: mid (content) says 'true damage resets' inside a long passage I did not touch this pass, and 'levels 6 through 11' there is an unsourced range — both worth a follow-up. Defiant Dance reducing PHYSICAL damage only (so Winds of War goes through it) is now on the page for the first time.
